text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring the Castellan Imperial for our company launch event, which is scheduled to take place on 29 April 2027 at 12:30 pm. We plan to return it on Friday, 30 April 2027 at 5:00 pm. We would appreciate it if the vehicle could be collected from your garage. Furthermore, I would like to request that one of your chauffeurs be available to drive the vehicle. I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Kind regards,
Victor Marrowby
